items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a Job Creation Tax Credit of 1.195% for 7 years on 2026-03-30 for a project in the City of Columbus, Franklin County. Commitment: create 60 full-time equivalent employees generating $3,071,000 in new annual payroll at the project location.

items.program_name: Business Development Tax Credit(WI WEDC・Tax Credit)
items.verbatim: WEDC Tax Credit under the Business Development Tax Credit program, awarded 2025-11-17 to a recipient in City of Green Bay, Brown County. Industry: Manufacturing (NAICS 311821). Award amount: $230,000. Planned project cost: $3,587,400. Planned capital investment: $3,587,400. Planned job creation: 23.
